name: e3_feedback_round2_quantifier_prompt
purpose: Round 2 on the same 26 candidates with the quantifier rules added to the prompt. EXPLORATORY: the rule was derived from the round-1 failure analysis of these very cases, so this arm is post-hoc tuning on the evaluation set and its number must never be reported as the headline result. Its point is to measure whether stating the rule adds anything beyond what the counterexample already shows (arm r2a).
prompt_provenance: repair_v6a: repair_v5 plus a contract bullet for the exists-quantified compare OP|, one sentence requiring the rearm wait to be not(C), and two checklist rows. Derived from the round-1 failure analysis of these 26 cases; on the 14-case dev set it scored below v5 (12.25 vs 12.75 over four runs)

model.note: greedy decoding, thinking off: 13/14 on the dev set at ~330 completion tokens; thinking on exhausted 8k/16k budgets on sustained-condition cases. ir_timing_facts = durations read off the IR in ms and 100 ms ticks (deterministic, no repair advice).

stop_rule: round 2 of 2; only cases still DIVERGE_CONFIRMED after round 1 are re-asked; exactly one model call per case in this round; INVALID_OUTPUT, NO_CHANGE and MODEL_ERROR are terminal and count as not repaired; no retry, no resampling; cases that reached EQUIV-FIXPOINT in round 1 are final and are not re-run; the 5 TIMEOUT and 1 MODEL_ERROR cases of round 1 have no fresh confirmed counterexample and are not eligible
evidence: F1 input history and F2 same-instant action mismatch from the first replay-confirmed divergence recorded in the E3 final run; F3 line-numbered current script; plus ir_timing_facts. No verifier internals, no gold code.

population.subset_note: the 26 cases still DIVERGE_CONFIRMED after round 1; the other 356 cases of the tag are unchanged and not re-run

baseline.result: round 1: EQUIV-FIXPOINT 36 / DIVERGE_CONFIRMED 26 / TIMEOUT 5 / MODEL_ERROR 1 of 68 (2026-09-16)

evaluator.policy: explorer.eval.frozen_contract, --unbounded (H=None), Explorer only, B5 selector assignments, E3 caps (200000 states / 500000 transitions / 100000 input combinations / 20 s x assignments / 768 MiB); source snapshot must equal the E3 final protocol's
evaluator.accepted: EQUIV-FIXPOINT only; DIVERGE_CONFIRMED, REFUSED, UNKNOWN, TIMEOUT, MEMORY_LIMIT, ERROR stay in the denominator of 68

reporting: repaired/26 in this round and the two-round total out of 68; by divergence type; every terminal status; tokens and wall time; raw responses under runs/<run-id>/responses/
limitations: single model, single greedy decode; not a stochastic estimate
dev-set prompt selection is prompt development, reported separately
binding/selector errors are outside the verification contract (B1/B5) and cannot appear here
the 68 candidates and their outcomes were inspected during the 2026-09-15 divergence audit; the prompt was not tuned on them
limitations_round2: post-hoc: the prompt addition was derived from these cases' round-1 failures; exploratory only, reported as a separate arm and never as the headline
